paper.title: SkillMOO: Multi-Objective Optimization of Agent Skills for Software Engineering
paper.central_claim: 技能包应以pass/cost多目标搜索；LLM编辑+NSGA-II留存Pareto配置，优于static，搜索开销可经复用回收，剪枝替换提供技能设计原则。

provenance.notes: 按已配置sonnet类型执行；环境标示gpt-6.1-sol，无独立运行凭据/会话ID可存，不额外探测。

sections_read: 固定v3全文§1–6、Tables1–4含全部16任务及参考/结尾；无附录，无manifest页图；未报告独立test split/额外优化器对照

evidence.quote: a skill can improve task success while substantially raising token cost, or introducing misleading guidance.
is a task-specific skill bundle: a subset or edited version of the skills exposed to the coding agent.
evidence.support_explanation: 优化对象是非权重harness技能，非生成软件本身

evidence.quote: receives each surviving bundle together with its evaluation evidence and decides what change is most likely to improve the pass/cost tradeoff
non-dominated sorting and crowding-distance tie-breaking on the two objectives below; the top-ranked survivors breed the next generation’s population.
Each method is run 10 times per task; a run passes only when its solution passes the full automated test suite, so pass rate is the fraction of passing runs.

we expanded every suite to 40–43 tests with GPT-5.4: behavior checks cover required functionality and safety checks reject invalid or unsafe outputs while retaining original compile/build gates. Each added test was checked manually against the task specification and reference environment, generated without skill content, and applied uniformly across methods.
evidence.support_explanation: 测试扩充和人工核查有价值；不等于独立holdout

evidence.quote: for both task solver and skill optimizer agents. The evaluation uses population size 4 and 3 generations
SD over 10 independent runs. #Skills is the mean number of skills in the selected bundle across runs (fractional values arise from run-to-run variation in the selected candidate).
evidence.support_explanation: 报告SD且选中bundle跨run变，搜索与最终重复计量层级未完全展开

evidence.quote: Inspection of execution logs shows that these four tasks share heavy or specialized runtime dependencies that stress container memory and build-time budgets, causing the agent to fail, therefore we exclude them from comparative analysis.
evidence.support_explanation: 16任务中四个全零，失败计入总表但HV只12

evidence.quote:
no_skill
still trails SkillMOO on pass rate for 11 of 12 non-zero-pass tasks.
evidence.support_explanation: static/no-skill比较显示搜索设置可提高分数，不证NSGA-II必要性

evidence.quote:
optimization costs range from $1.76 to $13.73. Dividing this one-time cost by the observed per-run saving over
ori_skill
yields an approximate cost-only break-even of 5–682 reuses (median 45)
evidence.support_explanation: 预算核算及摊销次数，后续真实reuse尚未测

evidence.quote: Although all search runs are paid before selection, the Pareto archive retains alternatives for a deployment budget or reliability target rather than simply choosing the highest-pass run.
evidence.support_explanation: 全搜索费用和留存archive；缺独立后续task部署验证

evidence.quote: Because the edits are filtered from search traces, RQ3 should be read as exploratory pattern evidence rather than an independent causal study.
evidence.support_explanation: 38 edits为筛选archive，非总体操作成功率

evidence.quote: Future work should test whether optimized bundles, edit heuristics, or routing policies transfer across unseen SE tasks and across different coding agents.
evidence.support_explanation: 跨未见task/model仍future work；无search/test独立分割

evidence.quote: they were produced by the same model family used for task solving, which may introduce shared reasoning biases in borderline cases
evidence.support_explanation: 与§4 GPT5.4扩充/GLM5 solver的说明不一致；不能据此断言同源泄漏
